component.name: Text
Text
component.summary: Edit plain text and source files

description.p: Text is a lightweight editor for plain text and source files. It opens files given on the command line and through a file chooser. UTF-8 documents are editable; binary and undecodable data use read-only previews.

ul.li: Crash recovery: unsaved changes in dirty or untitled buffers are written to a private per-user state file off the edit path and are offered for restoration on the next launch after an unclean exit, without overwriting the file on disk.

Printing: the active document is rendered to PostScript and sent to a printer through the desktop print portal. Characters outside Latin-1 are refused rather than substituted; when no portal is available the attempt reports that instead of failing silently.
Find and replace, go to line, and document statistics.
